title: Guild Ownership Map
description: The orchestrator's routing index: which profile owns which area of the project, and where that owner's knowledge lives. It holds pointers only. Knowledge itself lives in the owner's ledger (guild.profile-knowledge/v1) and, once consolidated, in project memory. Adding a knowledge statement here is a schema violation by construction: no property accepts one.

updated_by.description: Canonical profile id. Only the orchestrator maintains this map.

boundary.description: What falls inside this area and what does not. A definition of scope, never a finding about the area.

owner_profile.description: Canonical profile id of the single owner. Exactly one owner per area.

ledger.description: Path to the owner's knowledge ledger, where this area's accumulated knowledge actually lives.

claimed_in_run.description: Optional. Run record id in which the owner claimed this area.

paths.description: Optional. Concrete parts of the target project this area covers.

last_entry.description: Optional. Id of the most recent ledger entry for this area — a pointer the orchestrator can follow, not a copy of what it says.

open_questions.description: Ids of open questions recorded in the owner's ledger. Ids only: the question's text stays with its owner.

related_areas.description: Ids of areas whose owners this owner must coordinate with. This is what lets the orchestrator connect pieces without holding either piece.
